criteria: The executor identifies duplicated customer-key normalization, independently varying discount and fraud policies, repeated route position searches, and the unused for_tests production factory as concrete risks or maintainability problems.

It centralizes the duplicated transformation, separates named independent policies without hiding orchestration, represents route positions once, and removes the test-only factory while preserving public behavior.
It leaves the genuine production clock dependency and the single clear index lookup alone as false positives.
It avoids gratuitous patterns, changes only cohesion.py, and keeps the public suite green.
